description: This Java source file contains integration tests for share product datatable functionality within the Fineract project. It includes test setup, creation of datatables, and verification of datatable entries related to share products.

classes.name: ShareProductDatatableIntegrationTest
classes.description: A test class for validating datatable creation and entry operations related to share products in the Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured setup and configures request and response specifications for tests.

methods.name: testDatatableCreationForShareProduct
methods.description: Tests the creation of a datatable for share products and verifies the correct columns are created.

methods.name: testDatatableEntryForShareProduct
methods.description: Creates a share product, then creates a datatable and adds entries to it, verifying entries are stored correctly.

methods.name: createShareProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a share product using the ShareProductHelper utility.
